commands.name: design
commands.description: Create a design document (data structures, interfaces, complexity, data flow) and wait for approval before implementing
commands.prompt:
Use the `design-doc` skill. Gather requirements, analyse the codebase, and write the design document for the following feature under docs/design/. Catalogue every data structure (fields, types, where defined, invariants, persistence), the interfaces, algorithms with time and space complexity, data flow, error handling, testing and rollout. Present a summary and stop for approval. Do not implement anything until the design is approved.

Feature: $ARGUMENTS
